findings_and_reconciliations.classification: Independent corroboration of /root/hair_ops conditional observation; first discovery attribution retained; no automatic ledger identity or historical checkpoint credit.
findings_and_reconciliations.trace: CaptureGround::Terrain requests optional terrain height at each bone. Missing height becomes None; contact/toe clearance and terrain-relief metric functions omit absent samples, then use scalar zero when no finite samples survive. ScenarioMetrics retains those values; selected terrain nonpenetration and vertical range gates can evaluate zero as a measured value. P17 clearance explicitly carries unavailable per required missing bone or clearance, no-contact unavailable and no-flight NotApplicable instead. Model finite-transforms gate checks position/rotation rather than this clearance. Some IK support absences already produce required_ik_support errors independently.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: Only if a supported selected scenario requires one or more such foot/toe observations and its capture yields absent terrain support or no required applicable contact samples; an out-of-grid foot while root remains admitted is a source-permitted candidate, not a demonstrated supported trajectory. Some missing samples may be hidden by a partial aggregate; direction of its bias is not assumed. Other independent gates and artifacts may reject. No full accepted report, defect severity, supported missing footprint or runtime outcome established.
findings_and_reconciliations.direction: Establish the selected-scenario applicability and supported missing-ground producer first; then maintain measured/unavailable/nonapplicable through capture, metrics, derived acceptance bound and consumer. Retain authored-plane and off-mode semantics, independent thresholds and other gates. This is a future repair direction only.
